_comment: Pack EN 7: the dynamic briefing (the pilot asks the dispatcher for an update and the dispatcher answers by kind of mission, the crew presents itself), where the crew is left when the police drives it (landing spot far from the patient), and the doctor's report for a dead patient. Six options each: 1 default, 2 and 3 professional, 4 to 6 more colloquial; the futile ones have two silent options first and the default as third.

DSP.RQ.trigger: the pilot asks the dispatcher for an update after the tasking
o: Dispatch, HEMS. Tasking received. Request any update on the patient and the ground units.
Dispatch, HEMS, we copy the tasking. Please advise on the patient's condition and the units on scene.
HEMS to dispatch, tasking copied. Do you have any further information for us?
Dispatch, HEMS. Got the tasking. Anything new on the patient or the units?
Dispatch, HEMS. Copy the tasking, any updates for us before we go?
Dispatch, HEMS. Got it. Anything else you can tell us before we lift?

DSP.ANS.ACC.trigger: the dispatcher answers the pilot: accident
o: HEMS, dispatch. Copy. Casualties are reported at the scene and ground units are being dispatched. I will update you as soon as I have more.
HEMS, copy. The caller reports injured people at the scene. Ground units are on their way, and I will relay anything new.
HEMS, dispatch. No further details at the moment. Ground units are being tasked, I will keep you updated.
HEMS, nothing more from the caller yet. Units are rolling, I will call you with news.
Copy HEMS. Nothing new for now, units are on their way. I will shout if I get more.
Nothing more yet, HEMS. The ground units are rolling, I will tell you as soon as I hear something.

DSP.ANS.INJ.trigger: the dispatcher answers the pilot: injured only, the pilot chooses landing point and destination
o: HEMS, dispatch. The casualty is at the reported position. You choose the landing point and the destination, and I will support you on the radio.
HEMS, copy. The injured person is at the position in the tasking. The landing point and the destination hospital are up to you.
HEMS, dispatch. No ground units are tasked. You decide the landing area and the hospital, call me for anything you need.
HEMS, you are on your own for this one. You pick the landing spot and the hospital, call me if you need anything.
Copy HEMS. It is your call: landing point and hospital are yours. I am here if you need me.
HEMS, this one is all yours. Pick your spot and your hospital, and shout if you need anything.

DSP.ANS.SAR.trigger: the dispatcher answers the pilot: search and rescue
o: HEMS, dispatch. Copy. No further information on the person: the search is based on the last known position. Report as soon as you have contact.
HEMS, copy. The last known position is the only information we have. Please report on contact.
HEMS, dispatch. Nothing new on the search. Report when you have visual contact.
HEMS, nothing more on our side. You have the last known position, call me when you see anything.
Copy HEMS. That is all we have, the position is the last known one. Call me when you see them.
That is all we know, HEMS. Good luck out there, and call me the moment you find them.

DSP.ANS.TRF.trigger: the dispatcher answers the pilot: patient transfer
o: HEMS, dispatch. Copy. The sending hospital is expecting you and the patient is ready for transfer. The receiving hospital has been informed.
HEMS, copy. The patient is prepared at the sending hospital and the destination has been informed of your arrival.
HEMS, dispatch. Both hospitals are informed. The patient will be ready when you land.
HEMS, both hospitals know you are coming. The patient should be ready when you get there.
Copy HEMS. They are waiting for you at the pickup, and the destination knows you are on the way.
All set on both ends, HEMS. They are waiting for you at the pickup and the destination is ready.

DSP.ANS.ORG.trigger: the dispatcher answers the pilot: organ transport
o: HEMS, dispatch. Copy. The container is ready at the pickup and the receiving team is waiting. Please report your estimated arrival.
HEMS, copy. The organ is packed and ready for collection. The transplant team is waiting, report your ETA when you can.
HEMS, dispatch. Pickup is ready and the destination is on standby. The time limit is tight, report your ETA.
HEMS, the container is ready for you and the transplant team is waiting. Give me your ETA when you can.
Copy HEMS. They have the container ready. The destination is waiting, so call me with your ETA.
It is all ready for you, HEMS. The team at the destination is waiting, so call me with an ETA.

BRF.INT.PLT.trigger: the crew presents itself on board: the pilot
o: Good morning, everybody. I am flying today. Let's have a safe shift.
Morning, crew. I am on the controls today, so let's keep it safe.
Hi all, I am the one flying today. Let's have a good one.
Morning, team. I am flying today, so please be nice to me.
Copilot here. Navigation and radios are mine, and I watch for obstacles.
Morning. I am on navigation and radio calls, and I keep an eye on the surroundings.
Hi all. I take the maps and the radio, you take the coffee.
Hello, I am the copilot. I do the navigation, the radio and the shouting about obstacles.
Doc here. The medical care is mine on the ground, tell me what you see.
Morning. I lead the medical side, so tell me anything about the patient straight away.
Hi all. Medical is mine, so shout as soon as you see anything about the patient.
Hello, I am the doctor today. Patients are my business, coffee is yours.
Rear crew here. I look after the cabin, the stretcher and the hoist.
Morning. Cabin, stretcher and hoist are mine, ask me for anything.
Hi all. I take care of the cabin, the stretcher and the hoist.
Hello, I am the rear crew. Cabin, stretcher and hoist: if it has a strap, it is mine.

APR.PLT.P.trigger: 2 NM from the accident, the landing spot is far from the patient and the police will drive the crew (argument 0 = distance in meters)
o: Approaching the scene. We cannot land close to the patient: we land at the selected landing spot, about {0} meters away, and the police will take the crew to the patient.
Almost there. The landing spot is about {0} meters from the patient. The police will drive the crew to the scene.
Briefing: we land at the spot, {0} meters from the patient, and the police take the crew over.
Two miles out. We land at the spot, about {0} meters from them, and the police give you a lift to the patient.
Two miles out. The patient is {0} meters from our landing spot. The police take the crew there.
Almost there. We land at the spot, it is about {0} meters from them. The police will give you a lift.

APR.CHF.P.trigger: the crew is driven by the police from the landing spot
o: Rear crew: stretcher and bag ready, the police take us to the patient from the landing spot.
Chief: equipment ready. I follow Doc into the police car at the landing spot.
Rear crew ready. Stretcher and bag at the door, we ride with the police.
Chief here. Bag and stretcher are ready, we get a lift from the police.
Rear crew ready. Kit at the door, we hop in the police car.
Chief here. Everything is ready, we ride with the police when we are down.

GRD.DEAD.trigger: stage treatment or CPR with the patient dead
o: The patient has died. We confirm the death and finish the documentation, then we return to the helicopter.
Unfortunately the patient did not survive. We complete the documentation and come back.
Patient deceased. We are completing the formalities and returning to the helicopter.
We lost the patient. We finish here and come back to you.
We could not save them. We finish the paperwork and we are on our way back.
We lost them, I am sorry. Give us a moment to finish here and we come back.
